CustomField.description: Progress made to date as a percentage
CustomField.formula: IF( FinServ__TargetValue__c <= 0, 0, IF( FinServ__ActualValue__c <= 0, 0, FinServ__ActualValue__c / FinServ__TargetValue__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Progress made to date as a percentage
CustomField.label: % Progress Made to Date
